rows.amount_note: AWS Activate Credits start at $1,000. AWS says select participants may get more, up to $5,000 in total.

Up to one year of Kiro Pro+ for 2, 10 or 30 users (Starter, Growth or Scale tier). At the $40 per user per month Pro+ list price (kiro.dev/pricing, read 2026-11-02), that is $960, $4,800 or $14,400 (computed here); Kiro states seats, not dollars.

rows.program: AWS Activate credits through Mercury perks
rows.amount_note: Up to $5,000 in AWS Activate Credits for Mercury customers. If you already redeemed less than $5,000 in AWS credits, you get only the difference up to $5,000.
A fixed credit amount, recurring for 12 months, plus discounted startup pricing that continues after the credits. AssemblyAI does not state the dollar amount.
Kick-off credits of $1,000 to $25,000 for Denvr AI Compute Services. Up to $500,000 more in reward credits, earned from compute spend.
12 months of the Scale plan with 33,000,000 characters. The $5,500 figure is ElevenLabs' own valuation ("More than $5,500+ in value"), not a cash credit.
Every approved team starts with a $1,000 Startup pack. The $2,500 Scale pack unlocks at $1,000 a month of fal spend and the $5,000 Growth pack at $2,500 a month, each added on request.
FounderPass says free members get $25,000 to $100,000 in AWS credits, set by an unnamed partner. Its own FAQ says a company just starting out should expect much lower.

A 50% discount, not a credit: up to 10 IDE subscriptions, 10 team or learning tool subscriptions and 10 JetBrains AI subscriptions, for five years. Startups in a JetBrains partner's network get six months free (up to 10 licenses in total) and then the 50% discount.

rows.program: Lambda offer for NVIDIA Inception members
rows.amount_note: $1,000 in Lambda Cloud credits for on-demand GPU instances. Credits also cover persistent storage.

$300 in Supabase credits over one year for new Supabase customers. Mercury also lists an ElevenLabs grant of 12 months and 33 million characters, with no USD value stated. Microsoft for Startups (up to $5,000 Azure) and GitHub ($10,000, VC-funded only) are each partner's own program and are not counted here.

rows.program: Microsoft for Startups (standard path, no referral code)
rows.amount_note: $200 of Azure credit at sign-up, usable for up to 90 days. Business verification raises the total to $5,000 (another $4,800) for up to 180 days. Usage milestones then raise it to $25,000, $50,000 and $150,000, based on the number of Azure workloads and sustained spend.
Up to $15,000 in MongoDB Atlas credits. The amount depends on stage and investment partner, and MongoDB does not list per-tier amounts. The tiers are Inspire, Grow, Innovate and Scale.

Free months of the Business plan with Notion AI: 6 with a select partner and 3 with a business website and domain email. Companies under 10 employees get 1. Business costs $20 per member, billed annually. Notion values the offer at up to $12,000 for 100 employees.

The US program gives up to $12,000 of public cloud credits for 12 months, plus 6 hours with an engineer. The EU program states EUR 10,000 for the same level. The SCALE level, for Series A and later, gives up to $120,000 (EUR 100,000 on the EU site).

rows.program: Runpod Startup Program, Starter and Venture tiers
rows.amount_note: The Starter tier gives $1,000 in credits and the Venture tier gives $5,000. Credits work on Pods, Serverless, Clusters and Storage. Growth Track is a spend match: a $25,000 commit adds $10,000 in bonus credits, and a $50,000 commit adds $25,000.
EUR 9,000 in cloud credits over 6 months, not renewable, with on-demand access to a customer success manager. No dollar amount is shown because the page states euros only.
EUR 1,000 in cloud credits, valid 12 months and not renewable, usable on Scaleway's cloud products. No dollar amount is shown because the page states euros only.

rows.program: Scaleway Startup Program for NVIDIA Inception Members
rows.amount_note: Up to EUR 42,000 in cloud credits for Inception members, against EUR 36,000 for regular members. The page also gives 12 months of Advanced Support (about EUR 700 a year), one certification and one social media mention. No dollar amount is shown because the page states euros only.
Up to $100,000 in AWS credits, or 20% to 50% off monthly AWS spend, through an unnamed AWS partner. The partner sets the amount after a manual review.

The Atlas perk list names $5,000 of AWS Activate Credits, for new users only. It also names $5,000 or more of Azure credits through Microsoft for Startups. It names $100,000 of Cloudflare product credits through the Cloudflare Startup Program. Atlas also gives $2,500 in Stripe product credits for the first year. Those cover Stripe fees, not compute.

rows.provider: Tenki (Tenki Cloud, LLC, owned by Luxor Technology)
rows.amount_note: $10,000 in free credits on approval, for Tenki Sandboxes, GitHub Actions runners and the AI Code Reviewer. Tenki also matches purchased credit 1:1 up to $40,000, which needs your own spend.
A spend match, not free credit. Vast matches verified compute spend dollar for dollar in credits, up to a cap set per startup at approval.
Up to $200,000 in AWS Activate Credits. The amount depends on the offer your Activate Provider holds, and a later, larger offer pays only the difference.
$200,000 or more in AWS credits for AI startups that have outgrown Activate Portfolio. AWS gives no upper limit.
Evaluation access to AMD Instinct GPUs through partner clouds. The page states no price. Duration and capacity vary by partner.

rows.program: Claude Startups API credits through partner VCs
rows.amount_note: Up to $100K in additional Claude API credits for startups funded by a VC in Anthropic's partner network, claimed through the VC.
Up to $25,000 for Dedicated Inference or Training plus up to $2,500 for Model APIs. The $27,500 total is the sum of the two caps (computed here); the page gives no combined figure.
Free credits of an unpublished amount, plus private-preview access to new open-source models on Cerebras Inference.

$10,000 in GitHub credits on a GitHub Enterprise Cloud account. The credits pay Enterprise license (seat) costs and add-ons: Copilot (licenses, premium models, agentic features), Advanced Security and other metered offerings such as Actions.
No credit. Registered users request evaluation instances of Intel hardware, including Intel GPU and AI PC instances. The docs state no price.
Up to $30k of compute credits for Standard and GPU instances.

rows.program: Microsoft for Startups Investor Network offer
rows.amount_note: $1,000 of starter credits right after applying with a referral code. After approval, up to $150,000 of total credits, depending on eligibility and prior usage. Listed extras: Azure Standard Support (24/7), GitHub Enterprise (up to 20 users), Microsoft 365 Business Premium (up to 50 seats), Dynamics 365, Power Platform and LinkedIn Premium.
The page promises thousands of free GPU credits without a number. The Seed to Series A tier gets free credits; the Scaling and Series B+ tier gets custom credits.
Credit amounts are not published. The page offers introductory credits, compute savings and engineering support through Nebius VC partners.

Oracle Universal Credits for OCI services, from $5,000 to $60,000 per the UK terms; Oracle picks the amount. The Latin America rules give a range of $5,000 to $100,000. Selected companies may also get one year of Level 1 Oracle PartnerNetwork membership and Oracle Marketplace access.

rows.program: AMD Instinct MI300X Accelerator Trial on TensorWave
rows.amount_note: A free 72-hour MI300X trial. No dollar value is stated.
Build tier: up to $15K in platform credits plus 3 hours of forward-deployed engineering. The Scale tier ($5M to $10M raised) gives up to $30K and the Grow tier (over $10M raised) up to $50K.
Up to $30,000 in Flexible Commitment Amount, a prepaid Vercel balance where each unit is worth $1.00, plus Enterprise-tier access and startup support.
Up to $100,000 in cloud credits plus long-term discounts of 35%. The page does not say which Vultr products the credits cover.
